LESSON: SOIL

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL ENVIRONMENT Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learn
Topic 2.2: Soil
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Soil, part of NATURAL ENVIRONMENT Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learn in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can you identify different types of soil in our environment? 2.How do we model with soil?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Soil together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: Learning independently as learners model soil ribbons using the soil samples provided (clay, loam, sand...)

and observe to find out which soil samples make smooth long ribbons.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation skills as learners model objects (balls, ribbons, pots) with different types of soil(clay loam, sand) in groups

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
 Health promotion issues: Learners develop preventive health skills as they clean working areas, clean hands with soap and

water after handling soil to prevent communicable diseases.

48

Link to other Learning Areas:

 Creative Arts Aactivities: Modelling as learners model ribbons with different types of soil.

Approved learning support materials, soil samples, local environment-school neighbourhood with suitable environmental
